gloss: for now; for the time being; immediate

definitions.gloss: for now; for the time being; at present
definitions.explanation: Used to indicate that something applies to the current period, often implying the situation may change later.
Referring to matters that require immediate attention or are directly facing one.

examples.japanese: {当面|とうめん}は{今|いま}の{仕事|しごと}を{続|つづ}けるつもりだ。
examples.english: For now, I plan to continue my current job.

examples.japanese: {当面|とうめん}の{課題|かだい}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。
{当面|とうめん}、{予定|よてい}はありません。
examples.english: I have no plans for the time being.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{当|とう} (present, facing) + {面|めん} (face, surface)
Literally: "facing the present" → "currently"

GRAMMAR:
Can function as:
・Adverb: {当面|とうめん}、〜 (For now, ...)
・Noun modifier: {当面|とうめん}の〜 (immediate ~, current ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{当面|とうめん}の{目標|もくひょう} - immediate goal
・{当面|とうめん}の{課題|かだい} - pressing issue
・{当面|とうめん}の{間|あいだ} - for the time being
・{当面|とうめん}は - for now

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・さしあたり - for the time being
・{差|さ}し{当|あ}たって - for now
・{今|いま}のところ - at present
・ひとまず - for now, tentatively
